title: Support for a state badminton champion
summary: An alumna who represented the school nationally without professional coaching went on to win a Karnataka state doubles title. Alumni helped cover academy fees so she could keep training.
body:
### Nurturing Sporting Talent: Beyond Academic Support

The JNV Chikkamagaluru alumni community has always believed in the importance of supporting students in their educational journey. However, the community also realised that **support should not be limited to education alone**. While academic assistance remains an important priority, it is equally essential to recognise, encourage, and nurture young sporting talent. Sports teach discipline, perseverance, teamwork, and resilience, opening doors to opportunities that can transform young lives.

With this understanding, the alumni community came forward to support a promising alumna who had represented the school at the national level without professional coaching and later went on to win a **Karnataka State Doubles Championship title**. Recognising her talent, dedication, and determination, the alumni helped cover her academy fees, ensuring that financial constraints would not interrupt her training or stand in the way of her sporting aspirations.

This initiative reflects a broader understanding of the role of an alumni community—not merely to support education, but also to identify potential, encourage determination, and provide timely assistance to deserving young achievers in different fields. Just as educational support can open doors to knowledge and career opportunities, support for sports can help talented youngsters pursue their dreams and achieve excellence.

**This initiative marks an important step towards a broader vision of alumni support—one that nurtures not only academic excellence but also sporting talent, creativity, and the diverse potential of our young achievers.**

The JNV Chikkamagaluru alumni community remains committed to creating opportunities, inspiring confidence, and ensuring that deserving talent receives the encouragement it needs to flourish.

_Because every young achiever deserves a chance to shine, and sometimes, a little support at the right time can make all the difference._
archiveNote: Some personal and medical details from the original appeal have been removed to protect the family. The campaign and its outcome are unchanged.
